IV: two of its entries are the exports `zebakDefinition` and `nexusDefinition` of client/toa/, and the loop at the end of the module registers every entry (its kind, factory and descriptor, and each of its variant factories); "registered" keeps it apart from `encounterDefinitions` of engine/encounterKinds.js, the table of kinds and route slugs
CV: returns the definition's `kind` followed by the keys of its `variantFactories`; inferred wording
xV: a Map built from the pairs [kind, definition] for every kind `getDefinitionKinds` gives; `BV` reads it with a kind
WV: its `key` is "infiniteHealth" and its `label` "Infinite Health"; it is appended to every kind's `mechanicsToggles`
RV: its `key` is "infiniteSpecialAttack" and its `label` "Infinite Special Attack"; it is appended to every kind's `mechanicsToggles`
PV: a Map from each kind to the definition's `variantControls[kind]` or `controls`, with the two toggles appended to `mechanicsToggles`
_V: returns `controlsByKind.get(kind)`; what it returns is the value of a definition's key `controls`
NV: true when the kind's definition has `enableIntro === true`; application.js uses it as the default of an engine's `enableIntro`
GV: true when the kind's definition has a `countdownMovement` function that answers true for the mechanics; "has" is inferred
UV: returns `{ kind, mechanics: {} }` for a kind that has a definition, and otherwise the kind and mechanics of the definition whose `retiredEntries` holds the name (the Inferno's holds "zuk"); "resolve" is inferred

xE: the six loc ids the entries of the next table take their `locId` from; the scene of Sol Heredit builds one mesh per entry of that table and names it `sol-boundary-<localX>-<localY>` (rendering.js, the class with the field `boundary`)
BE: the scene's field `boundary` is built from it, each mesh named `sol-boundary-<localX>-<localY>`; the registry hands it to the arena's collision as `dynamicLocs`. Four runs of twelve placements: y 42, x 40, y 27, x 25
